dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The lateral surface features multiple O-shaped rings with jagged, high-contrast perimeters. The gradient shifts abruptly from the dark dermal background to the light-grey ring structure. The thickness of the rings is non-uniform, exhibiting pixel-level irregularities along the outer boundaries.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Solid clusters of high-intensity light-grey pixels are visible on the distal posterior flipper and the anterior dorsal region. These clusters appear amorphous and lack an internal gradient or dark core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent lateral rings form a scalene triangle. An obtuse angle is located at the most dorsal centroid, with the longest side connecting the anterior-most and posterior-most centroids of the group.
